memory_recovered: M-004, M-005, and M-006 are currently reported identifiers with unresolved origin, not verified continuity artifacts. Their existence as identifiers is observed; their historical assignment, semantic role, and artifact referents remain unresolved.

observed: The active queue describes M-004, M-005, and M-006 as reported continuity artifacts while requiring their provenance and location to be resolved.
Each first located repository record labels its value as reported_identifier, sets claim_status to unresolved, sets source_status to unlocated, and contains no accepted candidate source.
The temporal-boundary and search-visibility records explicitly refuse to treat later mentions as originating assignments.
inferred: Calling these identifiers artifacts without a qualifier can collapse an unresolved reference into an asserted historical object.
The stable ontology must separate identifier existence, assignment provenance, semantic meaning, and artifact referent.
proposed: Use reported_identifier for M-004, M-005, and M-006 until an immutable source explicitly assigns each identifier.
Use candidate_artifact only after a source names or contains a concrete referent, and accepted_artifact only after every resolution predicate passes.
Treat queue prose that says reported continuity artifacts as shorthand, not as provenance evidence.
superseded: Unqualified statements that M-004, M-005, and M-006 are known historical artifacts.
Using identifier mention, suffix similarity, semantic resemblance, or automation completion prose as proof of an artifact referent.
unresolved: Whether any of the three identifiers received a valid assignment before their unresolved-origin records.
Whether an assigned identifier, if found, refers to a file, decision, lexicon entry, project document, chat-derived memory, or another continuity object.

state_model.reported_identifier: The token is present in a source but origin and referent are not established.
state_model.candidate_assignment: An immutable source explicitly assigns the token, pending predicate evaluation.
state_model.candidate_artifact: A candidate assignment points to a concrete continuity object, pending predicate evaluation.
state_model.accepted_artifact: The assignment and referent satisfy explicit assignment, namespace, owner, semantic role, temporal precedence, immutable locator, and non-ambiguity requirements.
state_model.unlocated: No qualifying source has been found within declared non-exhaustive coverage.
state_model.not_found_after_exhaustive_coverage: All declared source classes and reachable repository history have been exhaustively traversed without a qualifying source.

falsification_route: Locate a pre-boundary immutable object that explicitly assigns one of the identifiers and names a concrete referent.
Evaluate that object against every resolution predicate and search for competing accepted origins.
If all predicates pass, promote only that identifier through candidate_assignment and candidate_artifact to accepted_artifact; otherwise retain reported_identifier and unresolved status.
